_about: Copy for the consequence boxes in new project (design.md §5.1, §5.2). Edit freely. {length} is replaced in custom.

treatment.talking-to-camera: Pieces to camera get their own beat, and audio becomes a must, not a bonus. Fewer inserts — your voice carries the cut.
treatment.silent: No pieces to camera and no lav needed. Your list will lean on ambience, hands, movement and light.
treatment.interview: A sit-down setup at the centre, with cutaways to cover the edit points and room tone for the gaps.
treatment.narrated: Visuals only, but plenty of them — voice-over can land anywhere, so every beat needs options.
treatment.scripted: Every shot is planned before the day, in the order the script needs them, with matched angles and continuity notes.

genre.brand: The client's deliverables stay pinned at the top of the list.

delivery.reel: Enough to cut a reel without shooting all morning.
delivery.mid: Enough for a five-to-ten-minute piece, with room for a sequence or two.
delivery.long: Enough for a ten-to-twenty-minute film, chapter by chapter.

deliveryTail: Both are a guide, not a rule.
